PalletTownOakText.ItsUnsafeText.en:
That was a dangerous spot! In the grass, wild Pokémon jump out!

If (you) too had a Pokémon with (you), (you) could fight, but... That's it!

...Come, follow me for a bit!

PalletTownGirlText.en:
I'm raising Pokémon too!

If (they) get strong, (they) can serve instead of a guard, you see.

PalletTownFisherText.en:
The power of science is amazing!

Nowadays, by computer communication, (they) turn tools and Pokémon into data and send them for you, (they) say.

PalletTownOaksLabSignText.en: Here is Professor Okido's Pokémon research institute.

PalletTownSignText.en: Here is Masara Town. Masara is pure white, the color of beginnings.

RedsHouse1FMomText.WakeUpText.en:
...That's right. Boys are things that someday set out on a journey. Yes... (I'm) talking about the TV!

Come to think of it, Professor Okido next door was calling for you.

RedsHouse1FMomYouShouldRestText.en: {player}...! How about resting a little before going...? ... ... ...

RedsHouse1FMomLookingGreatText.en: Oh my! You and (your) Pokémon are both full of energy! Then take care! Off you go!
RedsHouse1FMomLookingGreatText.loose: いってらっしゃい is the set phrase said to someone leaving.

RedsHouse1FTVText.StandByMeMovieText.en:
A movie is on the TV! Four boys are walking on the railroad tracks...

...I have to go too!

BluesHouseDaisyRivalAtLabText.en: Hello, {player}! (If it's) my little brother {rival} (you want), (he's) at grandpa's research institute.

BluesHouseDaisyOfferMapText.en: Grandpa Okido asked (you) to do a job, (I) hear? That's tough, isn't it. I'll give (you) this, so use it!

BluesHouseDaisyUseMapText.en: When (you) want to know the place you are or the name of a town, using the town map is good.

BluesHouseDaisyWalkingText.en: Just like humans, Pokémon are alive too! When (they) have no stamina, let them rest!

BluesHouseTownMapText.en: (It's) a map of the Kanto region! ...Would (you) be happy to get it?

OaksLabRivalText.GrampsIsntAroundText.en: What, (it's) {player}! If (it's) old man Okido (you want), (he) ain't here.

OaksLabRivalText.GoAheadAndChooseText.en:
Heh heh! I'm an adult, so I don't get greedy.

I'll let {player} choose first!

OaksLabRivalText.MyPokemonLooksStrongerT.en: The Pokémon I chose looks stronger.

OaksLabThoseArePokeBallsText.en: (They're) Monster Balls. There are Pokémon inside!

OaksLabYouWantCharmanderText.Text.en: Oh! The fire Pokémon Hitokage, (you'll) go with that?

OaksLabYouWantSquirtleText.Text.en: Hmm, the water Pokémon Zenigame, (you'll) decide on that?

OaksLabYouWantBulbasaurText.Text.en: I see! The plant Pokémon Fushigidane is good (for you)?

OaksLabMonEnergeticText.en: This Pokémon is really full of energy!

OaksLabLastMonText.en: Professor Okido's Pokémon, the last one...!

OaksLabOak1Text.WhichPokemonDoYouWantTex.en: Now, {player}, which Pokémon will (you) go with?

OaksLabOak1Text.YourPokemonCanFightText.en:
That's it! Even if a wild Pokémon comes out,

if (you) go on making that one fight, (you) can get to the next town!

OaksLabOak1Text.RaiseYourYoungPokemonTex.en: {player}, you too, don't lose out: make (your) Pokémon fight and raise it!

OaksLabOak1Text.DeliverParcelText.en:
Oh! {player}.

How is it? The Pokémon I gave... oh.

(It) seems to have taken quite a liking to (you)?

You have talent as a Pokémon trainer!

...Eh, something to hand to me?

{player} handed the delivery to Professor Okido!

Oh! This is the custom-made Monster Ball I had ordered. Thanks a lot!

OaksLabOak1Text.PokemonAroundTheWorldTex.en: The Pokémon living all over the world are waiting for {player}!

OaksLabOak1Text.GivePokeballsText.en:
Just finding Pokémon, detailed data cannot be obtained!

(You) absolutely must catch them! Here, for that purpose... I'll hand (you) the necessary tools!

{player} received 5 Monster Balls!

When a wild Pokémon jumps out, (that's your) chance!

If (you) throw a Monster Ball, toss!, (you) can catch the Pokémon!

However... whether (you) can take it well or not, (I) don't know!

Energetic Pokémon escape easily, and there's luck too!

OaksLabOak1Text.ComeSeeMeSometimesText.en:
Once in a while, show (your) face at my place!

The pages of the Pokédex, (I'm) curious about them, you see!

OaksLabOak1Text.HowIsYourPokedexComingTe.en: Good of (you) to come! How is the Pokédex going? Let's see... shall I take a little look!

OaksLabPokedexText.Text.en: There's something like an encyclopedia! Inside is nothing but white pages!

OaksLabGirlText.Text.en:
(He) may look like that, but Professor Okido is an authority on Pokémon!

There are many Pokémon trainers who respect the professor!

OaksLabOakChooseMonText.Text.en:
{rival}? ... ... ...

Oh, right. I was the one who called (you)! Wait a moment!

Here, {player}!

There are three Pokémon there, aren't there!

Ho ho!

Inside the Monster Balls, Pokémon have been put in.

Long ago I too made a name as a top-notch Pokémon trainer!

Now that (I'm) old and decrepit, only three Pokémon remain, but I'll give you one!

...Now, choose!

OaksLabRivalWhatAboutMeText.Text.en: Ah! Unfair! Old man! Give me one too!

OaksLabOakBePatientText.Text.en: Now now! Don't panic, {rival}! You take one you like too!

OaksLabOakDontGoAwayYetText.Text.en: Hey, where are (you) going! Come back!

OaksLabRivalIllTakeYouOnText.Text.en:
Wait, {player}! (We) went to the trouble of getting Pokémon from the old man!

...Try being my opponent for a bit!

OaksLabRivalIPickedTheWrongPokemonText.en: Eh, no way! (I) should have made it your Pokémon!

OaksLabRivalSmellYouLaterText.Text.en:
All right! I'll make (it) fight other Pokémon and make (it) stronger and stronger!

{player}! Old man! Well then, see ya!

OaksLabRivalWhatDidYouCallMeForText.en: (I) completely forgot! (You) have some business with me?

OaksLabOakIHaveARequestText.en: Oh, that's right! I have a request for you two.

OaksLabOakMyInventionPokedexText.en:
What's on the desk is the Pokédex I made!

The data of Pokémon (you) found is written in automatically and the pages increase,

a very high-tech encyclopedia, it is!

OaksLabOakGotPokedexText.en:
{player}, {rival}, I entrust these to you two!

{player} received a Pokédex from Okido!

OaksLabOakThatWasMyDreamText.en:
To make a perfect encyclopedia that recorded every Pokémon in this world!

That was my dream!

But I'm already an old geezer! (I) can't push myself that far!

So I want you two to fulfill the dream in my place!

Now, both of you, set out right away!

This is a great job that will remain in Pokémon history!

OaksLabRivalLeaveItAllToMeText.en:
All right! Old man! Leave it all to me!

{player}! Too bad, but there's absolutely no turn for you!

That's it! I'll borrow a town map from my sister and go!

I'll tell (my) sister not to lend (one) to {player}, so coming to my house is useless!

OaksLabScientistText.Text.en: I too, as the professor's assistant, am researching Pokémon.

RedBedroomSNESText.en: {player} is playing the Famicom! ... ...Okay! (It's) about time to head out!

BookcaseText.en: What's lined up on the bookshelf is nothing but Pokémon books.

OakLabEmailText.en:
Looking at the computer, why, an e-mail had come!

... ... ...

Pokémon trainers who raise Pokémon strong and fight! Here the strongest trainers have gathered.

The place is the Pokémon League headquarters on the Sekiei Plateau! Professor Okido, please come see it once too.

...From the Pokémon League ... ... ...

PushStartText.en: Push the start button! Pressing it opens the menu, it does.
PushStartText.loose: なり is an old-fashioned copula, like a robot or a textbook speaking.

SaveOptionText.en: To save, the Pokémon report. Writing it often is good, it is.

StrengthsAndWeaknessesText.en: Pokémon, depending on type, have types (they're) good against and types (they're) bad against, they do.

AccessedMyPCText.en:
Connected with (my) own computer!

Called up the tool deposit system!

NothingToDepositText.en: (You) don't have tools that can be deposited!

NoRoomToStoreText.en: The tools are full. No more can be deposited!

CantCarryMoreText.en: The tools are full. (You) can't hold any more!

See data
Cry
See distribution

DexCompletionText.en:
... ...The current degree of completion of the Pokédex is...

Pokémon found: {n}! Pokémon caught: {n}!

Professor Okido's evaluation...

DexRatingText_Own0To9.en: Not yet, not yet... (it's) just the beginning. Go into the grass here and there and catch Pokémon!

Rival1WinText.en: Yay! As expected, am I a genius?

PlayerBlackedOutText2.en:
At {player}'s hand there is no Pokémon that can fight!

Before {player}'s eyes, everything went pitch black!

TrainerAboutToUseText.en:
{trainer} seems about to send out {enemy}.

Will {player} also switch Pokémon?

NoRunningText.en: No good! In the middle of a match, (you) can't show (your) back to the opponent!

EnemysWeakText.en: The opponent is weakened! (It's a) chance!

UserNoText.loose: の, used when the move name reads as a noun: X's Tackle!

UserWaText.loose: は, used when the move name reads as a verb: X used Growl!

EndUsedMove1Text.loose: one of five endings the game picks per move: Xは Yを つかった！

PlayerBlackedOutText.en:
At {player}'s hand there are no more Pokémon that can fight!

Before {player}'s eyes, everything went pitch black!
